# Test image attribution

Openly licensed photos used as test fixtures. Licenses were checked against each source page on 2026-10-25.

Changes: every image has been downscaled to at most 1600 px on the long edge, re-encoded as JPEG (quality 85), and stripped of metadata. Any further changes are listed under the image.

Wikimedia Commons tags several of these files with a personality-rights warning: the license covers the photo, not the likeness of the person in it. These files are used to test image processing, and 01 and 02 (the Demo Images, see the README) to demo the app.
